g.title: pipeline
g.text: NYC TLC Trip Duration Reliability Pipeline

g.title: wx
g.text: no API key · local NY time

g.title: val
g.text: every failed row keeps its reason(s)
nothing is silently fixed or dropped

g.title: mdl
g.text: Trip event: one row per pickup → dropoff
joins Weather on the LOCAL pickup hour

g.title: model
g.text: flat event table · 1 row = 1 trip · 26 columns

g.title: met
g.text: expected duration = MEDIAN per zone-pair × hour
sparse cells fall back: zone → borough → citywide
(one shared flag, so metrics 2 and 4 cannot disagree)

g.title: note
g.text: weather joined on the LOCAL hour
they are the evidence for metric 5
metric 2 is a RELATIVE ranking, not
an absolute share of bad trips
